tool_input.command:
q(){ docker exec postgres psql -U postgres -d cchist -A -F '|' -t -c "$1"; }
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 3 AND 5"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id = 8"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND h.chars >= 400"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_call c WHERE c.model = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'"
q "WITH c AS (SELECT h.file_id, h.line_no, h.chars < 400 AND (h.ends_with_q OR h.question_start) AND NOT h.imperative AS is_q, lead(h.line_no) OVER (PARTITION BY h.file_id ORDER BY h.line_no) AS next_line FROM cchist.public.human_message h WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0) SELECT count(*) AS n FROM c WHERE c.is_q AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cchist.public.tool_call t WHERE t.file_id = c.file_id AND t.line_no > c.line_no AND (c.next_line IS NULL OR t.line_no < c.next_line) AND t.tool_name = 'Bash' AND NOT t.is_sidechain)"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1, 2) AND c.model = 'claude-fable-5'"
q "SELECT count(DISTINCT h.msg_id) FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 AND p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (3, 4)"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE r.validation_mark"
q "SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.model='claude-opus-4-8')/NULLIF(count(*),0) FROM cchist.public.call_danger_hit d JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = d.call_id WHERE d.pattern_id IN (1, 2)"
q "SELECT 100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tool_name='Bash')/NULLIF(count(*),0) FROM cchist.public.tool_result r JOIN cchist.public.tool_call c ON c.call_id = r.call_id WHERE r.denied_mark"
q "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT h.msg_id FROM cchist.public.human_message h JOIN cchist.public.message_pattern_hit p ON p.msg_id = h.msg_id WHERE NOT h.is_sidechain AND NOT h.is_noise AND h.chars > 0 GROUP BY h.msg_id HAVING bool_or(p.pattern_id BETWEEN 9 AND 11) AND bool_or(p.pattern_id BETWEEN 12 AND 15)) x"
